svg.aria-label: Historical NFIP payments by Census ZCTA, Pinellas-linked ZIP codes
svg.text: Historical NFIP Payments by Census ZCTA
Reported ZIPs linked to Pinellas in the HUD–USPS 2025 Q4 crosswalk
Cumulative nominal payments (building + contents + ICC); not a flood-risk rate
Source: FEMA NFIP historical claims; boundaries: Census 2025 TIGER/Line 2020-vintage ZCTAs.
Illustrative geography only. ZCTAs clipped for display; full ZIP payments shown, not area-allocated or predictive flood risk.
